review.reviewType: GPT-6 code-path audit plus current-main SHA and CI evidence reconciliation
controlsChecked: Exact D1-02 domain, luckreadpro database name, user-provided database UUID metadata, pinned Neon endpoint hostname and PostgreSQL major 18 guard.
TLS certificate-chain validation, hostname verification, sslmode=verify-full and channel_binding=require on remote connections.
GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch only from refs/heads/main with the exact D1-02 confirmation token.
Release gate validates this review record, exact reviewed Git blob SHAs and that the reviewed main commit is an ancestor of the dispatch commit.
Shared append-only ledger DDL constrains domain/database/owner mappings to the approved D1-02 W03/W05 domain.
Manifest pins W03 then W05 PostgreSQL artifacts, path-framed SHA-256 checksums, canonical manifest-entry checksums and ordered ledger-prefix idempotency.
One transaction per owner SQL migration and its ledger row, with a database-scoped transaction advisory lock held for the complete execution.
Preflight permits only a fresh public schema or an exact existing ledger prefix; retries reject drift and unexpected objects.
Postflight checks exact 28-table ownership, 63 indexes, 9 triggers, 10 trigger functions, zero business rows, only one Snowflake allocator row, zero foreign keys and no D1-03/W09 endpoint table.
Disposable PostgreSQL 18 CI exercises the full schema and rollback-only cross-owner event/reference semantics.
D1-01 shared migration readiness logic permits only the exact reviewed D1-02 state while retaining D1-03 through D1-05 blocked and the global remoteApplyReady flag false.
PR and push validation never read Neon credentials; remote apply remains a separate manual main-only workflow.
D1-01 remote validation workflow also runs shared runner and D1-01 planning regression tests after the D1-02 domain release state changes.
The refreshed D1-01 remote-runner review record was re-hashed and validated after adding the D1-02 per-domain release state; no circular review references are used.
limitations: PR #1643 had no submitted GitHub review records; this is a GPT-6 review record, not a human approval or GitHub APPROVE review.
Remote Neon DDL has not been executed. The CI database was a disposable PostgreSQL 18.6 service container.
GitHub repository secrets cannot be enumerated by this review tool; the workflow fails closed if NEON_DATABASE_URL_LUCKREADPRO is missing or does not match the pinned target.
The database UUID is pinned as user-provided Neon metadata; PostgreSQL does not expose this Neon control-plane UUID as a SQL identity field, so it is not independently verified by the connection.
